tc.subtitle: 資深分析師營運與策略報告 | 2026 年第三季業績專題
tc.source_line: 更新：2026/10/15。涵蓋截至 2026/09/30 的第三季，公司於 2026/10/14 公布業績。實績以公司公告及 SEC 申報為準；金額除另註外以百萬美元列示。市場共識另列來源與資料日期。 ANR 為包含新舊評級的整體共識快照。

views.title: 股票交易帶動增長，但季度高位回落顯示收入仍具週期性
views.text: 第三季淨收入 US$20,338m，按年增長 12%，按季下降 5%；攤薄 EPS 為 US$3.03，按年增加 8.2%。機構證券收入 US$10,029m，當中股票業務 US$5,799m、按年增長 41%，但固定收益收入 US$2,011m、下降 7%，投行收入 US$2,159m、僅增長 2%。我們認為，客戶交易及融資需求顯示平台競爭力，惟增長集中於股票業務，尚不能視為所有資本市場業務同步復甦；下一步須觀察投行收入能否接力，以及交易收入回落時的成本彈性。

views.title: 財富管理維持 30.4% 利潤率，巨額流入須看留存與收費轉化
views.text: 財富管理收入 US$9,065m，按年增長 10%；稅前利潤率為 30.4%，資產管理費 US$5,544m，淨利息收入 US$2,228m。收費型資產達 US$3,155bn，季度收費型資金淨流入 US$80.5bn；新增淨資產為 US$232.4bn，但略超過一半來自 IPO 相關資產，收費型流入亦包含一項企業退休金委託。我們認為，持續收費業務有助降低盈利波動，但不宜把本季總流入直接年化；資產留存、轉入顧問帳戶及實際收費收益，才是判斷未來盈利質素的關鍵。

views.title: 高回報與充足資本提供支撐，投資管理及費用壓力仍須消化
views.text: 公司 ROE 為 17.8%、有形普通股權回報率 ROTCE 為 22.6%，效率比率為 67%；標準法 CET1 為 14.9%。本季回購 US$1,540m，並宣派每股 US$1.15 股息。投資管理收入按年下降 12% 至 US$1,459m，績效及其他收入為負 US$106m，包含附帶權益沖回；長期資金淨流入則為 US$15.8bn。全公司信貸撥備 US$148m，主要來自機構證券。我們認為，資本與財富管理收入為回報提供緩衝，但績效費、信貸損失及薪酬費用仍會左右季度營運槓桿，不應僅憑資產規模增長推斷利潤持續擴張。

views.title: 估值已反映優質業務組合，目標價上行空間仍取決於盈利兌現
views.text: Bloomberg EEO 顯示 FY2027 調整後 P/E 為 13.30 倍，略高於 JPM 的 13.20 倍，並高於 GS 的 11.98 倍、BAC 的 9.89 倍及 C 的 9.46 倍；MS 的 FY2027 P/B 為 2.39 倍。ANR 整體共識評分為 3.93/5，包含 14 個買入、13 個持有及 1 個賣出；目標價 US$226.44 相對畫面參考股價 US$181.51 的潛在升幅為 24.8%，不含股息。我們認為，財富管理的經常性收入可支持相對溢價，但現有估值仍要求較高回報率得以維持。已核實公司材料未提供新的數字化 EPS 或收入指引。

risks.title: 交易收入及承銷活動回落：
risks.text: 股票業務收入按年增長 41%，但固定收益下降 7%，增長來源並不平均。客戶活動、波動率、融資需求或 IPO 與併購進度放緩，均可能使交易及投行收入回落，固定成本會放大盈利波動。

risks.title: 財富流入未必等於可持續收費增長：
risks.text: 新增淨資產 US$232.4bn 中，略超過一半與 IPO 有關；收費型流入亦包含大型退休金委託。資產流出、風險資產價格下跌、顧問費率壓力或現金配置改變，可能削弱資產管理費及淨利息收入，令 30.4% 利潤率承壓。

risks.title: 信貸、績效費及成本拖累：
risks.text: 公司信貸撥備 US$148m，機構證券佔 US$141m；該分部核銷 US$105m。投資管理附帶權益沖回顯示績效收入的不穩定性。借款人質素惡化、估值下調、薪酬及合規成本上升，可能限制營運槓桿。

risks.title: 估值及資本回饋對預期落差敏感：
risks.text: FY2027 調整後 P/E 13.30 倍高於本頁其餘同業，P/B 為 2.39 倍，要求盈利與回報率持續兌現。監管資本要求、風險加權資產增長或市場壓力可能減慢回購；ANR 目標價所示 24.8% 潛在升幅並非保證回報，目標價亦可能隨盈利預測及市場風險偏好調整。

sc.source_line: 更新：2026/10/15。涵盖截至 2026/09/30 的第三季度，公司于 2026/10/14 公布业绩。实际数据以公司公告及 SEC 申报为准；金额除另注外以百万美元列示。市场共识另列来源与数据日期。 ANR 为包含新旧评级的整体共识快照。

views.title: 股票交易带动增长，但季度高位回落显示收入仍具周期性
views.text: 第三季度净收入 US$20,338m，同比增长 12%，环比下降 5%；摊薄 EPS 为 US$3.03，同比增加 8.2%。机构证券收入 US$10,029m，其中股票业务 US$5,799m、同比增长 41%，但固定收益收入 US$2,011m、下降 7%，投行收入 US$2,159m、仅增长 2%。我们认为，客户交易及融资需求显示平台竞争力，但增长集中于股票业务，尚不能视为所有资本市场业务同步复苏；下一步须观察投行收入能否接力，以及交易收入回落时的成本弹性。

views.title: 财富管理维持 30.4% 利润率，巨额流入须看留存与收费转化
views.text: 财富管理收入 US$9,065m，同比增长 10%；税前利润率为 30.4%，资产管理费 US$5,544m，净利息收入 US$2,228m。收费型资产达 US$3,155bn，季度收费型资金净流入 US$80.5bn；新增净资产为 US$232.4bn，但略超过一半来自 IPO 相关资产，收费型流入亦包含一项企业退休金委托。我们认为，持续收费业务有助降低盈利波动，但不宜把本季度总流入直接年化；资产留存、转入顾问账户及实际收费收益，才是判断未来盈利质量的关键。

views.title: 高回报与充足资本提供支撑，投资管理及费用压力仍须消化
views.text: 公司 ROE 为 17.8%、有形普通股权益回报率 ROTCE 为 22.6%，效率比率为 67%；标准法 CET1 为 14.9%。本季度回购 US$1,540m，并宣派每股 US$1.15 股息。投资管理收入同比下降 12% 至 US$1,459m，绩效及其他收入为负 US$106m，包含附带权益冲回；长期资金净流入则为 US$15.8bn。全公司信贷拨备 US$148m，主要来自机构证券。我们认为，资本与财富管理收入为回报提供缓冲，但绩效费、信贷损失及薪酬费用仍会左右季度经营杠杆，不应仅凭资产规模增长推断利润持续扩张。

views.title: 估值已反映优质业务组合，目标价上行空间仍取决于盈利兑现
views.text: Bloomberg EEO 显示 FY2027 调整后 P/E 为 13.30 倍，略高于 JPM 的 13.20 倍，并高于 GS 的 11.98 倍、BAC 的 9.89 倍及 C 的 9.46 倍；MS 的 FY2027 P/B 为 2.39 倍。ANR 整体共识评分为 3.93/5，包含 14 个买入、13 个持有及 1 个卖出；目标价 US$226.44 相对画面参考股价 US$181.51 的潜在涨幅为 24.8%，不含股息。我们认为，财富管理的经常性收入可支持相对溢价，但现有估值仍要求较高回报率得以维持。已核实公司材料未提供新的数字化 EPS 或收入指引。

en.subtitle: Senior Analyst Operations & Strategy Report | Q3 2026 Earnings Special
en.source_line: Updated: 2026/10/15. Covers the quarter ended 2026/09/30, with results released on 2026/10/14. Actuals follow the company release and SEC filing. Amounts are in US$ millions unless noted; market consensus is separately sourced and dated. ANR is a broad consensus snapshot including older and newer ratings.

views.title: Equities Lead Growth, but the Sequential Pullback Shows Cyclical Exposure
views.text: Q3 net revenues were US$20,338m, up 12% YoY and down 5% QoQ; diluted EPS of US$3.03 rose 8.2% YoY. Institutional Securities generated US$10,029m, including equities revenues of US$5,799m, up 41%. Fixed income fell 7% to US$2,011m, while investment banking increased only 2% to US$2,159m. We believe client trading and financing demand demonstrate franchise strength, but growth remains concentrated in equities rather than a synchronized recovery across capital markets. The next tests are whether investment banking adds momentum and whether expenses remain flexible when trading revenues normalize.

views.title: Wealth Holds a 30.4% Margin; Exceptional Inflows Need Retention and Monetization
views.text: Wealth Management revenues rose 10% to US$9,065m, with a 30.4% pretax margin, US$5,544m of asset-management fees and US$2,228m of net interest income. Fee-based assets reached US$3,155bn and fee-based flows were US$80.5bn. Net new assets totaled US$232.4bn, but just over half came from IPO-related assets, while fee-based flows included a corporate retirement mandate. We believe recurring fees help stabilize earnings, but annualizing this quarter’s headline inflows would overstate visibility. Retention, conversion into advisory accounts and realized fee yields are more useful tests of future earnings quality.

views.title: Strong Returns and Capital Cushion Softer Investment Management and Expense Pressure
views.text: Reported ROE was 17.8%, ROTCE was 22.6% and the efficiency ratio was 67%; standardized CET1 was 14.9%. Morgan Stanley repurchased US$1,540m of shares and declared a US$1.15 quarterly dividend. Investment Management revenues fell 12% to US$1,459m, with negative US$106m of performance-based and other income, including a carried-interest reversal, despite US$15.8bn of long-term inflows. Firmwide credit provisions were US$148m, mainly in Institutional Securities. We believe capital and wealth revenues provide resilience, but performance fees, credit losses and compensation still shape quarterly operating leverage; asset growth alone does not establish sustained margin expansion.

views.title: Valuation Reflects the Business Mix; Target Upside Still Requires Earnings Delivery
views.text: Bloomberg EEO shows FY2027 adjusted P/E of 13.30x, slightly above JPM at 13.20x and above GS at 11.98x, BAC at 9.89x and C at 9.46x. MS trades at 2.39x FY2027 P/B on the same screen. ANR’s broad consensus score is 3.93/5, with 14 buys, 13 holds and 1 sell; its US$226.44 target implies 24.8% price upside from the displayed US$181.51 reference, excluding dividends. We believe recurring wealth revenues can support a relative premium, but the valuation requires strong returns to persist. No new numerical EPS or revenue guidance was verified in the reviewed company materials.

risks.title: Trading and Underwriting Activity Can Reverse:
risks.text: Equities revenues rose 41% YoY while fixed income declined 7%, leaving growth uneven. Softer client activity, volatility, financing demand or IPO and M&A execution could reduce trading and banking revenues, with fixed costs amplifying earnings volatility.

risks.title: Wealth Inflows May Not Become Durable Fee Growth:
risks.text: Just over half of US$232.4bn in net new assets was IPO-related, and fee-based flows included a large retirement mandate. Outflows, lower risk-asset prices, advisory-fee pressure or changes in cash allocation could weaken fee revenues and net interest income, putting the 30.4% pretax margin under pressure.

risks.title: Credit, Performance Fees and Expenses Can Weigh on Returns:
risks.text: Firmwide credit provisions were US$148m, including US$141m in Institutional Securities, which recorded US$105m of charge-offs. The carried-interest reversal in Investment Management illustrates performance-income volatility. Weaker borrower quality, valuation markdowns and higher compensation or compliance expenses could limit operating leverage.

risks.title: Valuation and Capital Returns Are Sensitive to Expectation Gaps:
risks.text: FY2027 adjusted P/E of 13.30x exceeds the other peers shown here, while P/B is 2.39x, requiring sustained earnings and returns. Capital requirements, risk-weighted-asset growth or market stress could slow buybacks. The 24.8% upside implied by the ANR target is not a guaranteed return; targets can change with earnings forecasts and market risk appetite.
